claims.text: The tweets were annotated for stance as either Favor or Against, focusing on two football clubs as targets.
A total of 700 tweets were annotated, with an equal distribution of 175 tweets for and against each target.
The annotated dataset is publicly available in CSV format, containing tweet IDs, target names, and stance classifications.
